tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2604 Carrier Grade IP Phone with PoE & Without Adapter is a powerful and cost-effective business communication solution designed for enterprises, offices, call centers, and service providers. Featuring support for up to 6 SIP accounts and 3 line keys, this carrier-grade IP phone delivers exceptional voice quality, advanced telephony features, and enterprise-level security.


Built for large-scale deployment, the GRP2604 offers centralized management through Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS), allowing organizations to easily configure, monitor, and manage devices remotely. With HD audio, noise shield technology, 5-way audio conferencing, and integrated Power over Ethernet (PoE), the phone ensures crystal-clear communication and simplified installation.


The Grandstream GRP2604 is an ideal choice for businesses seeking reliable VoIP communication, enhanced productivity, and long-term operational efficiency.


Key Features


  • Supports 3 lines and up to 6 SIP accounts
  • Integrated Power over Ethernet (PoE)
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • Noise Shield Technology for reduced background noise
  • 5-way audio conferencing support
  • Dual switched Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • 132 x 48 backlit LCD display
  • Enterprise-grade security protection
  • Centralized provisioning and management via GDMS
  • EHS support for Plantronics, Jabra, and Sennheiser headsets
  • Zero-touch provisioning for easy deployment
  • Wall-mountable and desktop installation options
